tasks.title: Verify chakra page navigation button exists
tasks.notes: Check that s3b.yaml has a navigation button on the main/settings page that leads to chakra_page. If missing, add a touch button or nav button in the existing menu area that calls id(disp)->show_page(chakra_page). Validate with: esphome config s3b.yaml

tasks.title: Verify chakra_mode_switch entity is registered
tasks.notes: Ensure s3b.yaml has a switch entity named chakra_mode_switch (template switch) that: on turn_on stops voice_assistant and sets chakra_mode_active=true; on turn_off sets chakra_mode_active=false and resumes voice_assistant. Validate with: esphome config s3b.yaml

tasks.title: Verify text sensors for HA integration are defined
tasks.notes: Check that s3b.yaml defines two text_sensor entities: 'chakra_active_name' and 'chakra_active_color'. Both should use ESPHome native API (no MQTT needed). If missing, add them. Validate with: esphome config s3b.yaml

tasks.title: Verify FFT interval/script exists for chakra analysis
tasks.notes: Check that s3b.yaml has an interval or script that runs every 200ms when chakra_mode_active==true. It should call id(chakra_analyser)->push_samples() and id(chakra_analyser)->get_info() via C++ lambda, update globals, and trigger display refresh. Validate with: esphome config s3b.yaml

tasks.title: Full compile validation
tasks.notes: Run 'esphome compile s3b.yaml' and confirm it builds without errors. Fix any remaining C++ or YAML errors. This task only passes when the full compile succeeds (not just config validate).
